title: Moonglade
body: Moonglade is the sacred valley of the druids, a hidden forest ringed by mountains between Felwood and Winterspring, reached only through the tunnels of Timbermaw Hold. The demigod Cenarius once dwelt here, and here Malfurion Stormrage gathered the first druids into the Cenarion Circle. After Hyjal the glade was opened to druids of every race under Keeper Remulos, son of Cenarius, and its wardens allow no fighting, so Horde and Alliance meet here as guests. Yet tensions grow between the glade and the Arch Druid of Darnassus.

title: Nighthaven
body: Nighthaven is the village of Moonglade and the seat of the Cenarion Circle, a quiet cluster of night elf halls and moonwells on the shore of Lake Elune'ara. All who respect nature are welcome on one condition, that the balance be kept, and the Moonglade Wardens end any hostility without question. Keeper Remulos's majordomo Rabine Saturna receives visitors, and the eccentric archivist Umber, a human, keeps the Circle's records.

parts.body: A book pried from a silithid hive in Silithus, crusted in chitin, proves to be a journal in a very ancient dialect of Darnassian, extremely valuable to the Circle.

title: Keeper Remulos
body: Keeper Remulos, son of the demigod Cenarius, keeps Moonglade, the sacred heart of all druidic study. He welcomed the tauren into the Circle, and there is open tension between him and Arch Druid Fandral Staghelm. Of late he speaks of the Emerald Dream with grave unease: it has become a dangerous place, and he fears for those who gave up their waking lives in hopes of saving it.

parts.body: Cleansed in Lake Elune'ara, an object carried from a corrupted dragon brought Malfurion's spirit before him. A Nightmare born of an ancient evil fights them in the Dream, Malfurion said: Ysera's noble brood has fallen to the old whisperings.

title: Shrine of Remulos
body: West of Nighthaven stands the Shrine of Remulos, honoring the keeper who guides the Cenarion Circle in preserving nature and its balance. The warden Tajarri expects every visitor to behave as befits sacred ground, at least those who would rather not meet her scimitar, and young druids end their trials of the water here.

parts.body: For a stricken crusader in Icecrown, Remulos names his shrine among the places most closely tied to the Emerald Dream, and sends a champion into the Dream from here, where nightmares lie in wait.

title: Stormrage Barrow Dens
body: The hills of southeastern Moonglade hold the Stormrage Barrow Dens, where night elf druids sleep while their spirits walk the Emerald Dream. They are named for Malfurion Stormrage, who slept within them through the ages until the Third War, when Tyrande Whisperwind fought her way into Moonglade to wake him.

parts.body: Malfurion's sleeping body lies here again in the Circle's keeping while his spirit fights in the Dream, which is why the corrupted dragon Eranikus longed to cross into the waking world: to destroy it.
sources: warcraft.wiki.gg/wiki/Stormrage_Barrow_Dens (sacred chambers of sleeping druids, named for Malfurion who slept within; body left in the den under the Circle's care until the War Against the Nightmare; a den overrun by Nightmare creatures in TBC)

parts.body: Cenarion dreamwardens guard the druid Clintar Dreamwalker, who sleeps in the southernmost den. Woken briefly, he believes a force from outside has invaded the Emerald Dream.
